faq_heading: Homes near Semiahmoo Trail Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Semiahmoo Trail Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Semiahmoo Trail Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Semiahmoo Trail Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Semiahmoo Trail Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 67 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,880,000, townhomes $975,000, condos $588,900. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Semiahmoo Trail Elementary?
faq.a: For the 67 homes that sold within 1 km of Semiahmoo Trail Elementary, the median time on the market was 39 days and the median sale was 97.2% of list; 1% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Semiahmoo Trail Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Star of the Sea (1.7 km south-east), Chantrell Creek Elementary (2.0 km south-west) and White Rock Christian Academy (2.1 km south-east).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Semiahmoo Trail Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Semiahmoo Trail Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Semiahmoo Trail Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Semiahmoo Trail Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 67 homes sold within 1 km of Semiahmoo Trail Elementary: 21 houses, 20 townhomes and 26 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $588,900.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Semiahmoo Trail Elementary

12 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Semiahmoo Trail Elementary in a straight line (8 elementary, 2 other, 2 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Star of the Sea, 1.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Bayridge Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Elgin Park Secondary (2.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Elgin Park Secondary (2.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Star of the Sea (1.7 km south-east), Chantrell Creek Elementary (2.0 km south-west), Rosemary Heights Elementary (2.2 km north-east), Morgan Elementary (2.3 km east), Jessie Lee Elementary (2.7 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Star of the Sea, 1.7 km south-east of Semiahmoo Trail Elementary.
